idea-plugin.name: Acpira
idea-plugin.description:
Native harnesses. One considered interface.

Bring Grok Build, Kimi Code, Devin and any other ACP agent CLI into a tool window or an editor tab. The agents keep their own execution engines; Acpira adds a clear execution history, inline approvals, queued follow-ups, session and account management, and a context budget.

Sessions, accounts and settings live in ~/.acpira, shared with the Acpira extension for VS Code and Cursor. Requires an IDE from 2026.1 on; the Marketplace package carries the native Acpira backend for each supported OS and CPU, with no Node.js required.
